lines.speaker: Rynn
lines.text: The northern pass is closed through winter. Mudslides. You'd have to go around through Kethvin.

lines.speaker: Rynn
lines.text: Two if you know the logging roads. I can draw you the route.

lines.speaker: Rynn
lines.text: No tariffs. No customs either. No one official lives out there anymore.

lines.speaker: Suri
lines.text: That's either very good for business or very bad for staying alive.

lines.speaker: Rynn
lines.text: You know the prices in Verath still?

lines.speaker: Suri
lines.text: I know the prices everywhere. Verath's paying double for tanned hide right now. Something about a uniform contract with the garrison.

lines.speaker: Rynn
lines.monologue: She says it like she's placing a card on the table. No bluffing. Just stating inventory.

lines.speaker: Suri
lines.monologue: And there it is. The conversation two practical people have instead of saying 'we should work together.'

lines.speaker: Suri
lines.text: Twelve, and I handle all the talking.

lines.speaker: Suri
lines.text: Where'd you learn to forage like that? The stuff you pulled today — half of it I wouldn't have recognized as edible.

lines.speaker: Rynn
lines.text: My mother. And hunger. Hunger's a good teacher if it doesn't kill you first.

lines.speaker: Suri
lines.monologue: I don't push. You don't push someone who mentions hunger like it's a person they used to know.

lines.speaker: Rynn
lines.text: Where'd you learn to read people like that?

lines.speaker: Suri
lines.text: My mother. And debt. Same principle, I suppose.

lines.speaker: Rynn
lines.monologue: She nods once. That's enough. We understand each other.
